title: Shell Stitch Scarf
description: A drapey scarf built from repeated shell motifs for texture without complicated shaping.
expectationText: A relaxing repeat project where the challenge is keeping shell spacing tidy and building a rhythm that stays consistent across long rows.

steps.title: Chain the base
steps.instruction: Make a foundation chain in a multiple that fits your shell repeat and scarf width.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Work the setup row that creates anchor spaces for the shells.

steps.title: Row 2
steps.instruction: Work shells into each anchor space, keeping the same stitch count in every shell.

steps.title: Repeat the pattern
steps.instruction: Alternate the setup row and shell row until the scarf reaches your preferred length.

steps.title: Finish the edge
steps.instruction: Add a final row or border if needed, then fasten off and weave in ends.
